candidates.notes: Assessment recorded after the focused drawing/lighting experiment. This is not a retrospectively passed foundation workflow. Two preceding colour revisions are preserved in output/.

criteria.evidence: The profile, horns, open toothed jaw and green flame are legible.
The cheek plates appear attached to a smooth head; the jaw hinge and horn roots remain schematic.
Green accents and a brighter jaw are visible, but much of the neck has broad generic shading and the fire lacks convincing interaction with the mouth.
Directional marks soften edges, but repeated constructed forms and uniformly treated surfaces remain unlike the reference.

issues.correction: Redraw the large masses and attachment transitions before further detailing.
issues.observation: Facial armour and horn roots do not explain the anatomy convincingly.

issues.correction: Study explicit lit and occluded planes at the mouth and cheek.
issues.observation: Surface light is only partially related to the nearby flame.

issues.correction: Use selective, form-specific painting; more global texture is not a solution.
issues.observation: Procedural surface treatment is too uniform to approach the reference.

review.strengths: Smaller eye is less cartoon-like than the first render. Turbulent fire and irregular scales improve specific defects.
review.weaknesses: Below the requested artistic standard. No independent or human pass. One composition; this experiment did not demonstrate the complete foundation-first process.

plan.brief: Focused experiment: an original 2D dragon head illuminated by green fire. Compare with the user-supplied oil-style dragon reference. No image generation, image inputs or 3D.

references.application: Use an open jaw, smaller eye and reflected green light as the focus of a new profile drawing. No reference pixels are used.
references.observation: The reference combines a complex skull and overlapping horns with small sharp focal details, broken painterly edges and green illumination on mouth-facing surfaces.

criteria.description: A readable dragon head breathing green fire.
Convincing skull, jaw hinge, neck transition and horn attachments.
Fire illumination describes local form with coherent falloff and shadow.
Purposeful brushwork and varied edges comparable with the supplied reference.

stages.goal: Assess this experiment without declaring artistic success from technical validity.
